posts.title: Let there be comments!
posts.description: There has been a lot of talk about website comments on Bubbles . I think it started with a post by Forking Mad , and a bunch of replies are linked at the bottom of that page. My blog posts have had a "Reply by e-mail" button for years. Some of them also link to other places where you can comment. posts.title: From Casio to Pebble and back
posts.description: My first watch was a Swiss analog watch from an unknown brand 1 . It was given to me by my parents and had a Hilti logo on it. They most likely got it for free when they bought something. By the time it finally broke, smartphones were gaining popularity. I was using an LG Cookie (and later an iPhone 3G) at that time. posts.title: Bots are dominating the web
posts.description: The last few years, web traffic from bots has increased rapidly. Some sources 1 claim that automated activity now accounts for over half of all web traffic. This is even more pronounced on small websites like mine, as I don't receive many human visitors.
